brief:
The Electronic Intifada reported that Israeli soldiers have left feces and condoms in West Bank homes during operations in the territory. The incident is part of broader reporting on Israel's actions in the West Bank, where the outlet characterizes military conduct as part of an ongoing genocide.

The report comes amid continued tensions over Israeli military operations in Palestinian areas and allegations of soldier misconduct during home incursions and searches.
dek: Zena Al Tahhan on Israel’s ongoing genocide in the West Bank. Ali Abunimah reacts to the US midterm elections. Jon Elmer on the latest in the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Israeli soldiers leave feces, condoms in West Bank homes
